title: Framework Intro
slide_intent: Explain why a framework comes first: the reader needs a principle for choosing how ingredients fit together.
strategic_value: A recipe metaphor can make a design system feel native to Instacart’s subject.
demonstration: A short line compares the framework to a recipe and occupies a small portion of a pale page.
practical_value: Decide how to describe the relationship between the organizing idea and the design elements before specifying either.

content_islands.spec: Place the two-line dark statement at the left, with generous open space around it.
